title: Israeli Draft Law Talks
body: Rav Elya Ber Wachtfogel, South Fallsburg rosh yeshiva, has been in high-level talks with Israeli Gedolei Roshei Yeshiva about the government's draft-law proposal, reaching out to senior yeshiva leaders before presenting it to Rav Moshe Hillel Hirsch.

title: Missing Teen Found in Yarkon River
body: 19-year-old Eliyahu Abba Shaul, missing since Wednesday, was found dead in the Yarkon River after a four-day search. ZAKA volunteers located his body on Sunday afternoon.
